name: se.curity.identityserver.haapi.android.ui.widget.HaapiFlowActivity
description: The Curity Identity Server HAAPI UI.Widget SDK opens this Activity from a configured sign-in link. It displays the identity server's sign-in steps, such as forms or passkey verification, until the user finishes or cancels.
disableEffect: Users cannot complete sign-in or account verification flows provided by the Curity Identity Server.
